buildings.name: Temple of Artemis
buildings.title: A Temple of Artemis at {polis}
buildings.description: Raise the goddess a house of dressed stone. Her priests will remember who paid for it.

buildings.name: Grand Bazaar
buildings.title: The Grand Bazaar of {polis}
buildings.description: Roof the market in colonnades and give the traders room to haggle. The treasury will take its share.

buildings.name: Granary
buildings.title: The Granary of {polis}
buildings.description: Stone bins for the harvest, against the lean years. The landowners will sell into them.

buildings.name: Walls
buildings.title: The Walls of {polis}
buildings.description: Ring the town in stone. Its fortifications rise by one.

buildings.name: Port
buildings.title: The Port of {polis}
buildings.description: Deepen the harbor and lay new slipways. The shipwrights will follow the work.
